title: Creamy Turkish Anchovy Bowl
description: A flavorful and savory dish combining creamy sauce with Turkish spices and salty anchovies, served in a bowl.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together the Turkish red pepper flakes, minced garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil.
3. Arrange the anchovy fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
4. Brush the anchovy fillets with the garlic-lemon mixture and season with salt.
5. Bake the anchovies in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until crispy.
6. Meanwhile, soften the cream cheese in a separate bowl.
7. Once the anchovies are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly.
8. Spread the softened cream cheese on the kissed bread slices.
9. Top each bread slice with a few anchovy fillets and a sprinkle of salt.
10. Serve the creamy Turkish anchovy bowl immediately.
